title: Flag customers at high scam risk from onboarding attributes

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each customer is assigned a scam-risk score using predefined rules based on age, digital literacy, and account activity.
A customer whose score meets or exceeds the defined threshold is flagged as 'very high risk'.
The 'very high risk' flag is written to continuously-updated customer reports, with each customer's details accessible in the system.
The rules and threshold used to determine very high risk are documented and recorded alongside the watchlist.
A customer missing attributes needed for scoring is identified rather than silently omitted.
